issue.title: Alert across hosts when vault-sync halts
issue.description: Add cross-host alerting for a newly halted bob vault-sync cycle, including headless athena and apollo. The current incident plan removes the broken bob notify calls because they cannot reach anyone on those servers; this feature needs its own delivery and deduplication design.

task_type_fields.proposal: Provide a reliable cross-host alert when bob vault-sync enters its repeated-merge halt state, including on headless athena and apollo.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved tale fixes sync recovery and removes a dead local notification call. Choosing and implementing a cross-host delivery channel is a separate capability with transport and recipient decisions.

issue.creation_reason: The approved vault-sync repair makes repeated merges halt safely, but a halt on a headless host can remain unnoticed. Track a cross-host alert channel as a separate capability.
